title: Synchronize Diagram Pan And Zoom
summary:
Completed fix for drag child piece output design. The core issue was twofold:

1. Child piece center not updated: dragPiecesInDesign only produced a ConnectionDiff for child pieces (updating connection u/v), but the diagram renders from piece.center. The output design (applyDesignDiff result) had no piece center change, so it looked identical to the input.

2. Descendant propagation missing: when a piece moves (root or non-descendant child), all its descendants in the flat design must also receive piece center updates so the entire sub-tree visually follows the drag.

Fix in dragPiecesInDesign:
- Built a childrenMap (reverse of parentMap) for transitive descendant lookup.
- Added getAllDescendants helper using BFS over childrenMap.
- Root pieces: update center (absolute = current+offset) for the piece AND all its descendants.
- Non-descendant child pieces: connection diff + center update for the piece AND all its descendants.
- movedGuids set prevents duplicate updates when the same descendant is reachable from multiple primary movers.
- Updated test assertions: Nakagin test now verifies the primary piece update and that every update shifts by exactly the offset (all 79 pieces in the sub-tree).
